description.name: PayBridgeNP
description.tagline: One integration for every Nepali payment method.
description.long:
## The fastest way to accept Nepali payments in WHMCS.

PayBridgeNP is a payment aggregator for Nepal. Install this module once and your customers can pay WHMCS invoices with **eSewa**, **Khalti**, and any method PayBridgeNP adds in the future — no second configuration, no second reconciliation.

Payments are collected on a hosted, mobile-friendly checkout page. Server-to-server webhooks (HMAC-signed) are the authoritative confirmation, so invoices are marked paid even if a customer closes their browser on the redirect back.

Sign up at [paybridgenp.com](https://paybridgenp.com). Setup walkthrough at [docs.paybridgenp.com/integrations/whmcs](https://docs.paybridgenp.com/integrations/whmcs).
features: eSewa + Khalti in one module — no per-method configuration, no duplicate webhook endpoints.
Full refund support from inside WHMCS admin, including partial refunds.
Test mode with sandbox keys — zero risk to real customer funds during setup.
Gateway Log integration with automatic secret scrubbing — safe to share with support.
Optional Public Callback URL override for installs behind a load balancer or in local dev.
